name: Yasamin — Daily technology draft desk
purpose: Implementation-neutral recipe for Activepieces. Recreate each step with the matching built-in piece in the installed Activepieces version.

steps.config: Load enabled sources from automation/source-registry.ts and fetch items from the last 36 hours.
Map items to source, canonical URL, published time, title and excerpt. Reject invalid or duplicate canonical URLs.
Use ai-prompts/editorial-agent.md. Keep only high-impact items relevant to Yasamin's topics. Require a primary source for claims about a vendor release.
Produce one object matching content-engine/publication.schema.json per approved candidate, in English and Persian.
Reject missing sources, invented statistics, empty FAQ, duplicate slugs, clickbait titles and unsupported claims.

guarantee: The endpoint forces status=draft and featured=false. Publishing remains a human admin action.
